protocol.candidates: Union of independent image944 and joint1051 natural SHA-unique Top10; each reranker only uses its own original ten. Diagnostic positives never inserted.
protocol.frame: EXIF-oriented normalized [0,1], historical token geometry transformed from DECODED_RAW_BEFORE_EXIF
protocol.save: Native FP32 bidirectional warp/confidence for fixed diagnostic pairs; FP32 native-map samples at EVERY frozen token center plus a fixed64x64 grid for EVERY pair.
protocol.homography: RANSAC seed17, source points inside human box, overlap>=0.5, cycle distance<=0.05, threshold0.02 in normalized reference coordinates; no labels. If <4 or failed, geometry score0 and feature score falls back to visibility.
protocol.selection: All original173validation: macroTop1, macroMRR, smaller weight, fewer added constraints. Historical exploratory only.
controls: feature MaxSim with no coordinate penalty
limits: RoMa provides extra visual features; a gain is not proof ColNomic itself encodes all layout.
A single homography is a planar approximation; foldouts/multiple faces violate it.

color_protocol.input: Original EXIF-oriented RGB; existing human query box; no OCR and no identity label.
color_protocol.resize: Longest side <=384, PIL thumbnail default bicubic; Lab through OpenCV RGBfloat32.
color_protocol.score: Confidence-weighted exp(-Lab_ab_distance/20) for saved query->reference64x64 matches inside subject; cyclic error<=0.05 and overlap>=0.5; chroma reliability=min(max(query_chroma,reference_chroma)/30,1). If no colored reliable correspondence,0.
color_protocol.control: Same samples/weights, reference colors half-grid rolled before distance.
color_protocol.selection: Prespecified weight grid and173validation only; additional exploratory family.
